payload.text: I read this as a read-only visual QA review of three Orca Lite screenshots plus the UI source — I'll inspect all captures and source files in parallel, then deliver a PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict with tagged findings.
Three distinct states confirmed. Now the source.
Now the remaining source: TabBar, Sidebar, workspaceStore, and the token layer.
Now cross-check the design token layer and the split-view test to confirm behavior claims.

Important discrepancy: `tailwind.config.js` defines only `background`/`foreground`, yet components use dozens of tokens (`bg-sidebar`, `h-titlebar`, `w-sidebar`, `border-border`, `max-w-tab`, `bg-terminal`...). Let me check whether the served preview build matches this source, and inspect the pixels at the divider.

The dist bundle is fresh (08:50) and matches the capture times. Let me verify the served build actually contains this component code (real React, not a raster/mock) and confirm the token situation in the built CSS.

This is the core defect: the app is genuine React, but **~50 semantic design tokens referenced across every component resolve to nothing** in the shipped CSS. Let me quantify and confirm this against the screenshots.

Confirmed and quantified. Only `bg-background`/`text-foreground` (the two tokens in `tailwind.config.js`) resolve; **36 of 38 semantic color tokens plus all custom sizing tokens are dead classes**. This explains exactly what I see in the screenshots. Let me verify the visual consequences pixel-by-pixel.

Divider is `rgb(229,231,235)` — Tailwind's **default** `border-l`/`border-t` gray-200, not a themed `border-border`. Confirms the token failure and explains the glaring white hairline. Let me verify the geometry defects I suspect in the vertical case and the terminal clipping.

I have everything needed. Both split states render two real xterm instances, all three states are visually distinct, and the transitions match the reducer — but the theme layer is broken in the shipped build.

## Verdict: REVISE

The interaction contract works. The visual layer is running on a **half-missing design system**, and it is visible in all three captures.

### Blocking

**1. [evidence] 36 of 38 semantic color tokens resolve to nothing in the shipped CSS.**
`ui/tailwind.config.js` extends only `background` and `foreground`. Every other token used across the components — `bg-card`, `bg-sidebar`, `bg-worktree-sidebar`, `bg-accent`, `bg-muted`, `border-border`, `border-input`, `bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-primary-foreground`, `bg-status-*`, `ring-sidebar-ring`, `bg-terminal` — plus every custom sizing token (`w-sidebar`, `h-titlebar`, `h-tabbar`, `min-w-tab`/`max-w-tab`, `max-w-error`) and `animate-enter`, `scrollbar-none` — produce **zero rules** in `dist/assets/index-Cfx2PEwT.css` (verified by grep against the served bundle; only `.bg-background` and `.text-foreground` exist).

Pixel proof: sidebar `(9,9,11)`, header `(9,9,11)`, tab bar `(9,9,11)`, active tab `(9,9,11)`, inactive tab `(9,9,11)` are all the *same* color in all three captures. The sidebar/main seam at x=189 shows no border. The intended hierarchy — sidebar vs. card vs. terminal, active vs. inactive tab — is entirely absent.

**2. [product] Divider renders as a stark white hairline, not a themed border.**
`border-l`/`border-t` fall back to Tailwind's default gray-200. Measured `rgb(229,231,235)` at x=734 (horizontal, `/tmp/orca-lite-final-split-horizontal.png`) and y=390 (vertical, `/tmp/orca-lite-final-split-vertical.png`). On a `#0a0a0a` terminal this is a maximum-contrast white line — the single most visually dominant element in a screenshot whose subject is a terminal. `border-border` was clearly intended.

**3. [product] Active tab is visually indistinguishable from inactive tabs.**
`TabBar.tsx:28` selects `bg-background` (active) vs. `bg-card` (inactive). `bg-card` is dead, so both render `(9,9,11)`. The only surviving affordance is the 2px `bg-foreground` underline at `TabBar.tsx:56` — and `bg-foreground` *does* resolve, which is the sole reason "main (3)" is identifiable as active. One thin underline is carrying the entire tab-state signal.

**4. [product] Vertical split has an asymmetric ~5px dead band above the divider.**
At y=385–389 across the full width the pixels are `(9,9,11)` — the app background showing through — then the divider at y=390, then terminal `(10,10,10)`. The horizontal split has no equivalent gap (clean `(10,10,10)` right up to x=733). This is xterm's fitted row height not filling the flex box; the leftover is unpainted. Visible as a subtle seam discontinuity between the two orientations.

**5. [product] Bottom of the vertical split is clipped/unpainted.**
At x=600, y=716–719 reads `(9,9,11)` instead of terminal black — the lower pane does not reach the viewport bottom, leaving a ~4px background strip. The horizontal split's divider correctly extends to y=719.

### Passing

- **[evidence] Genuine interactive React, not a raster.** `dist/assets/index-C2RjTJQ0.js` (built 08:50, matching capture times 08:48–08:49) contains `terminal-layout`, `secondary-pane`, `Split terminal`, `ROTATE_SPLIT`, `DISABLE_SPLIT`, `useReducer`, and React `createElement`. Two independent xterm instances render live content with separate blinking cursors — visible in the horizontal capture where the left cursor is filled at (224,123) and the right is a thin bar at (766,123), i.e. independent blink phase. That is impossible in a static image.
- **[evidence] Cycle none → horizontal → vertical → none is correct.** `App.tsx:76-84` matches `layout.ts` `ROTATE_SPLIT`/`DISABLE_SPLIT`. All three captures are pixel-distinct; the final unsplit frame has zero light seams in the main area (verified by column and row scan), and the a11y tree reports `Split terminal (none)` with one terminal input.
- **[evidence] Counts are self-consistent.** 3 tabs / 3 agent cards / badge "3" / "Active agents 3" / "Worktrees 1" / 1 worktree card — matches `selectAgents` deriving agents 1:1 from `layout.tabs`.
- **[product] Split control has correct affordance.** Icon swaps `SplitSquareHorizontal` → `SplitSquareVertical` (`WorkspaceHeader.tsx:52-56`), and the accessible label carries live state. The icon change is legible between the horizontal and vertical captures at ~(1234,17).

### Rationale

Behavior is sound — reducer, panes, and state cycling all verified against source and pixels. The problem is Phase 1 of the design-system workflow was skipped: components were written against a rich semantic token vocabulary that `tailwind.config.js` never defines, so the build silently drops it. Nothing errors; the UI just flattens to one near-black value with white default borders. Findings 1 and 2 are one root cause and fixing the config resolves both plus finding 3; findings 4 and 5 are separate flex/fit geometry bugs in `TerminalSplitView`/`TerminalPane`.

Read-only review — no files modified, no git writes.
